gaps.lead: Someone must check this equipment before every flight.
gaps.explanation: must check → must be checked (modal + be + past participle).

gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ we left early.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: This is the best coffee I've ever tasted.
gaps.explanation: 'The best I've ever tasted' → 'never tasted better'.

gaps.lead: Phoebe was surprised to be offered a place on the course.
gaps.sentence: The offer of a place on the course ___ Phoebe.
gaps.hint: surprised by = come as a surprise to
gaps.explanation: 'Was surprised' becomes 'came as a surprise to her'.

gaps.lead: I'd love to be able to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could expresses regret about ability or possibility.
